text: Competitor X’s strategy of aggressive price cutting combined with targeted digital marketing poses a significant threat to our market position. By absorbing short-term losses to gain long-term loyalty, they are attempting to lock in customers who are price-sensitive, particularly the younger demographic they are actively courting through social media. This dual approach of undercutting prices and shifting consumer perception could erode our market share and negatively impact our sales figures. To mitigate this, we must evaluate our pricing elasticity, reinforce our brand value proposition beyond price, and enhance our own digital engagement strategies to retain and attract key customer segments.
